list: The official 55 trophies, checked 2026-11-18 against PowerPyx and GTABase, whose lists agree.

trophies.guide: Finish the other 54 first. Nothing here is online and there is no difficulty setting to worry about — the platinum is a straight sum of the rest of the list, most of it the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks on its own as the story opens.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1. It lands when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2. It lands as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3. It lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4. It lands when the final mission of that chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing else depends on how you play it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Story only, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play Headliners in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Work the 35-item 100% checklist in the Checklist tab (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, after the story). It is closer to 60% of everything in the game — most things are only partly required, and nothing on it is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Check Progress > Activities for what is left.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold at all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges. Ranges also raise Focus, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each spot while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Repeating the same race does not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1), then follow his fishing quests when he texts you a purple-marked spot. Beat him in his fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game end to end. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts an address in Belville. Do his five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton marks treasure dives with purple chest icons after Island Dreams (Chapter 1). Dive at the markers, use the metal detector to dig up each chest, and bring the haul back. Clear 7 shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts again later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Do Billy's five jobs in order, ending with Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands that count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Watch the trophy's own progress counter. None are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3) you get the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage in west Vice City; scan cars with WAiNK to check them against the list. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach are good hunting.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City until Tyrone's last job, Shut Down the Labs, appears.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; doing a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — it adds +1, is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spot needs both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. 100% needs only 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), Bret texts you; start with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, then hunt the animals on his purple-marked Target Decks and bring them back. Which animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total). Progress > Collections shows each set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app (hold Up, then R1/RB): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; Progress > Challenges ticks finished ones. 100% needs 70, so this comes along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters are together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2), call your partner, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in armoured, with sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City are close together. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. 100% needs 200 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). Fill Focus first (eat, drink, wash up; Adrenaline stretches it), use an assault rifle, and pick gang-operation thugs — cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal a big passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge (not one parked on the airfield). Gates E3/E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs, back out, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County (tanks at the south end of the base) and shoot enemies from inside it until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) you have the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewellery store's locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm — find the safe code in the back room and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4). Follow a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner — one person cannot carry it all. Vaults always give 4 stars: leave on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Any 5 of the 8 vaults; 100% needs all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts, as long as you escape the heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Earlier, box in an armoured truck, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is fastest — fly over every dark patch until nothing is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation (yellow icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. 100% needs all 39.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Exact steps unconfirmed — GTABase lists this as not yet confirmed, so treat any specific bar claim with care.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3) first. GTABase notes the exact steps are not yet confirmed; PowerPyx names this Banshee method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling, Chapter 2), take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs). It pops once you lose the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs together — training one trains the other — or at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Most players get it without trying. Do not push to Irredeemable — it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Exact steps unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is not confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange. Exact steps unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is tied to a UFO questline, but that is not confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. Exact steps unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check (Chapter 3) you have the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best. It is a running total, and the 100% robberies get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across every kind of shop, running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (after Daily Driver, Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After Moses' Chapter 2 mission you have the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. Use cheap cars and keep garage space free.
trophies.name: On the Spot

xbox: Same 55 achievements on Xbox Series X|S, 1,000 Gamerscore in total; the platinum is a 0G Mythic achievement on Xbox.
